source.note: Upstream publishes no specification version identifier, no tags and no changelog. The version above is this repository's dated pin: the date of the upstream commit this table was transcribed from.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Skill identifier; 1-64 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, matching the parent directory name

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the skill does and when to use it; 1-1024 characters

fields.name: license
fields.description: License name, or a reference to a bundled license file

fields.name: compatibility
fields.description: Environment requirements: intended product, system packages, network access

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Arbitrary mapping of string keys to string values for properties the specification does not define
